title: Restriction from a principal chart is localized
statement: Let $S$ be an $\mathbb N$-graded commutative ring with grading $\mathcal A$, let $M$ be an $S$-module, and set $X=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-nagata-affine-proj]. Index charts by pairs $f=(a,d)$ with $d>0$ and $a\in S_d$. Put $D_f=D_+(a)$, $R_f=S_{(a)}$ [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero], $N_f=M_a$, and let $Z_f\subseteq N_f$ be $R_f$-submodules, where the scalar action on $N_f$ is restricted from $S_a$. For each inclusion $D_g\subseteq D_f$, suppose ring maps $\rho^S_{f,g}:R_f\to R_g$ and additive maps $\rho_{f,g}:Z_f\to Z_g$ are given. Let $U_{f,g}\in R_f$ have image $g^{\deg f}/f^{\deg g}$ in $S_f$. Suppose additive equivalences $\theta_{f,g}:(Z_f)_{U_{f,g}}\cong Z_g$ and ring equivalences $\theta^S_{f,g}:(R_f)_{U_{f,g}}\cong R_g$ are given for all these inclusions, with $\theta_{f,g}(q/1)=\rho_{f,g}(q)$, $\theta^S_{f,g}(r/1)=\rho^S_{f,g}(r)$ and $\theta_{f,g}(tq)=\theta^S_{f,g}(t)\theta_{f,g}(q)$. Assume every $\rho^S_{f,g}$ is induced by an $S$-algebra map $S_f\to S_g$. Let $F$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with additive equivalences $\alpha_f:F(D_f)\cong Z_f$, compatible with scalar multiplication via awayToSection and with restriction via $\rho$. Fix f and r in R_f. Put E=F restricted to D_f and V=e inverse D(r), with e the canonical affine chart isomorphism. Let k:R_f to O_Df(V) send x to the restriction to V of its pulled-back constant. Let b:E(top) to Z_f be alpha_f composed with restrictAppIso and the identification of the image of the terminal chart open with D_f. Give E(V) its R_f-module structure along k. Every R_f-linear map l:Z_f to E(V) satisfying l(q)=(b inverse(q)) restricted to V has the three localization properties at powers of r: each power of r acts invertibly on E(V), every section has a power-of-r multiple in the image of l, and equality of two l-images is killed by a power of r.

source.place: Tags 01M4 (1)(e),(h), 01M7 and 01MB, last paragraph; read on https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01M4, /01M7 and /01MB

proof.text: Write r=a/f^n using Away.mk_surjective and choose g=f*a of degree deg(f)+n*deg(f). The toSpec membership formula and basicOpen_mul identify the image of the principal open with D[g]. Injectivity of HomogeneousLocalization.val and the fraction equality criterion prove U(f,g)=r^deg(f), with denominator cancellation witnessed by 1.

For any chart inclusion, evaluate the two proposed restricted constants at each projective point. The maps S_f to S_p agree because both commute with the algebra map from S; IsLocalization.ringHom_ext proves equality. The awayToSection evaluation formula identifies the corresponding sections. basicOpenToSpec_app_top and appLE_map then identify the pulled-back constant k with the restricted chart constant. Construct beta explicitly from restrictAppIso, transport along the equality of image opens, and alpha_g. Scalar naturality and hscalar give its rhoS-linearity, while functoriality and hrestriction give beta(l(q))=rho(q). Compose beta with theta inverse; htheta makes this an R_f-linear equivalence psi and proves psi(l(q))=q/1. Thus l is the standard localized-module map followed by psi inverse; IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv proves localization at U.

Transfer localization from powers(U)=powers(r^d) to powers(r) using IsLocalizedModule.of_exists_mul_mem. The inclusion follows from powers_le. For x=r^n choose the multiplier r^(n*(d-1)); its product with x is (r^d)^n because d=deg(f)>0. These algebraic identities include zero rings, r=0, nilpotent r, units, and empty charts without a separate case split.

proof_origin.note: Original three-step route fully formalized with Mathlib localization, projective-chart and module-restriction lemmas; no new holes or dependencies.

theorem gradedModuleChart_restriction_isLocalized
    (Z : ∀ f : Fidx, Submodule R[f] N[f])
    (rhoS : ∀ (f g : Fidx), D[g] ≤ D[f] → R[f] →+* R[g])
    (rho : ∀ (f g : Fidx), D[g] ≤ D[f] → Z f →+ Z g)
    (U : ∀ (f g : Fidx), R[f])
    (hU : ∀ (f g : Fidx), (U f g).val = Localization.mk (g.val.1 ^ f.val.2)
      (⟨f.val.1 ^ g.val.2, ⟨g.val.2, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f.val.1))
    (theta : ∀ (f g : Fidx), D[g] ≤ D[f] →
      LocalizedModule.Away (U f g) (Z f) ≃+ Z g)
    (thetaS : ∀ (f g : Fidx), D[g] ≤ D[f] → Localization.Away (U f g) ≃+* R[g])
    (htheta : ∀ (f g : Fidx) (i : D[g] ≤ D[f]),
      (∀ r : R[f], thetaS f g i (algebraMap R[f] (Localization.Away (U f g)) r) =
        rhoS f g i r) ∧
      (∀ q : Z f, theta f g i (mk q 1) = rho f g i q) ∧
      (∀ (r : Localization.Away (U f g)) (q : LocalizedModule.Away (U f g) (Z f)),
        theta f g i (r • q) = thetaS f g i r • theta f g i q))
    (hcanonical : ∀ (f g : Fidx) (i : D[g] ≤ D[f]),
      ∃ l : Localization.Away f.val.1 →+* Localization.Away g.val.1,
        (∀ a : S, l (algebraMap S (Localization.Away f.val.1) a) =
          algebraMap S (Localization.Away g.val.1) a) ∧
        ∀ r : R[f], (rhoS f g i r).val = l r.val)
    (F : ModX) (alpha : ∀ f : Fidx, F.val.obj (op D[f]) ≃+ Z f)
    (hscalar : ∀ (f : Fidx) (r : R[f]) (s : F.val.obj (op D[f])),
      alpha f ((awayToSection 𝒜 f.val.1 r) • s) = r • alpha f s)
    (hrestriction : ∀ (f g : Fidx) (i : D[g] ≤ D[f])
      (s : F.val.obj (op D[f])),
      alpha g (F.val.map (homOfLE i).op s) = rho f g i (alpha f s))
    (f : Fidx) (r : R[f]) :
    let e := basicOpenIsoSpec 𝒜 f.val.1 f.property.2 f.property.1
    let E := Scheme.Modules.restrict F D[f].ι
    let V := e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r
    let k := (e.hom.appLE ⊤ V (by simp)).hom.comp
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R[f])).inv.hom
    let b := ((F.restrictAppIso D[f].ι ⊤) ≪≫
      F.presheaf.mapIso (eqToIso D[f].ι_image_top.symm).op).addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv.trans
        (alpha f)
    letI : Module R[f] (E.val.obj (op V)) := Module.compHom (E.val.obj (op V)) k
    ∀ l : Z f →ₗ[R[f]] E.val.obj (op V),
      (∀ q : Z f, l q = E.val.map V.leTop.op (b.symm q)) →
      IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers r) l
